Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class ClientParameters

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Parameters
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.ClientParameters
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    KristenHttpClientParameters, MulticastParameters, TcpClientParameters, UdpClientParameters
    public abstract class ClientParameters
extends Parameters
    Base class for parameters used to configure KDC clients. Client parameters define client-specific settings such as the remote address and synchronous reply timeout.

    Client parameter instances are created using the builder provided by the protocol-specific client parameters class.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    Client, Parameters

    • Method Detail

      • getClientType

        public ClientType getClientType()
        Gets the type of this client. The client type identifies the role the client has in the KDC connection and indicates whether it is operating on the client or server side. This is set by KDC.
        Returns:
        the client type.

      • getRemoteAddress

        public InetSocketAddress getRemoteAddress()
        Gets the remote address associated with this client. The remote address identifies the network endpoint to which this client communicates.
        Returns:
        the remote socket address.

      • getSyncReplyTimeout

        public long getSyncReplyTimeout()
        Gets the amount of time a synchronous send waits for a reply before timing out.
        Returns:
        the synchronous reply timeout in milliseconds.
